newsitem.title: USA: BRC Holdings sale of unit delayed.
newsitem.headline: BRC Holdings sale of unit delayed.

text.p: BRC Holdings Inc said Tuesday the sale of its election business has been delayed pending an antitrust review, adding first quarter results will be hurt by this continuing process.

The company reported fourth quarter earnings per share declined to $0.36 from $0.44 in 1995 and stated results for the quarter are preliminary and subject to material changes based on completion of the company's annual audit in March.

Chief executive P. E. Esping said the quarter was affected both by the company's announcement of its agreement to divest of its election business as well as poor results from its health care technology business.

The pending divestiture has resulted in delays in purchases of election systems, reducing fourth quarter revenues. "Additionally, as we continue our efforts to reposition our health care technology business, results from these operations have been weak."

Esping also said the closing of the sale of the company's election business to American Information Systems Inc has been delayed pending the conclusion of an antitrust merger review by the Department of Justice, Antitrust Division.

"Election sales will continue to be delayed by customers until the DOJ completes its review and we are able to consummate our planned transaction with AIS. As such, our first quarter results will be negatively impacted by this continuing process," said Esping.
